//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// controller_host_erase_tb — host CMD_ERASE on cell A, cell B untouched
//
// NOTE: Phases 1 and 2 use CMD_PROG. In this controller, every PROG runs
//       S_PROGRAM then S_VERIFY — that is normal weight programming, not erase.
// Phase 3 is CMD_ERASE only (RTL erase_from_host): expect state=4 (ERASE) only,
//       then idle — no PROG/VERIFY after host erase.
//
// Cell A: addr 0xb6ef  PROG weight 3
// Cell B: addr 0x76ef  PROG weight 4
// Address layout (16b packed): {PE[15:14], SA[13:10], ROW[9:6], COL[5:0]}
// Pulse encoding (binary b2b1b0): HIZ=000 READ=001 PROG=010 ERASE=011 INF=100
//
// TB: CLK_PERIOD=5 ns (timescale 1ns/1ps)
// controller_pkg (ann_controller defaults unless overridden):
//   TREAD=2  PULSE_NUM_READ=1  PULSE_TOTAL_READ=2
//   TPROG=5  PULSE_NUM_PROG=1  PULSE_TOTAL_PROG=5
//   TERASE=2  PULSE_NUM_ERASE=1  PULSE_TOTAL_ERASE=2
//   TINF=10  PULSE_NUM_INF=128  PULSE_TOTAL_INF=2176
//   MAX_PROG_RETRIES=3
//   USE_WEIGHT_PULSE_LUT=1 (DUT param; 1 => PROG_WRITE length from weight_pulse_lut.mem)
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
